# `em maint sync`

- **Usage:** `em maint sync [REPOS]…`

Sync repositories (git, rsync)

## Arguments
- **`[REPOS]…`** — Repo names from repos.conf (default: auto-sync enabled repos)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
